name: Johnny Hana
imageAlt: Johnny Hana website shown on a desktop display
body: Johnny Hana came to us in a critical moment — frustrated by delays and missed opportunities from a previous designer, they had lost nearly six months of momentum during their crucial startup phase. Within just two weeks, we completely turned things around.

We revamped their entire digital presence, redesigned their packaging for a more premium and cohesive brand experience, and relaunched their eCommerce store with a faster, more user-friendly layout. From product visuals to functional performance, every detail was crafted to reflect the brand’s high-quality, Hawaii-grown identity.

Now, Johnny Hana is positioned for growth with a stunning brand, a smooth shopping experience, and a loyal customer base — a line of CBD, CBC, CBG, CBN, and CBT-infused topical products inspired by healing, crafted with aloha.
result: Sales increased by 33% in the first 90 days.
